Added public-boundary guards and replaced platform-specific test paths with tmp_path. Kept MA27 pending for its SH11 evidence gate.

technical-summary: Implemented the versioned machine-scoped ManagedService record and atomic lease coordinator using existing foundation paths, atomic JSON I/O, TransitionEngine, timeline, redaction, and StartupLock authorities. Added heartbeat, status/lease inspection, registered public error codes, stale revision/epoch rejection, and redacted operational facts. Validated concurrent acquire/release/expiry and stale writers with spawned processes on Windows and in the clean Linux Docker suite.
user-summary-candidate: Added reusable, atomic shared-service lifecycle records and client leases, with cross-platform concurrency protection and isolated mutation tests.

technical-summary: Implemented reusable managed-service start-or-attach and guarded shutdown as cohesive foundation modules. Independent clients serialize discovery, detached launch, readiness/identity handshake, and lease acquisition under the PR06 service lock. Attach and stop require PID plus matching non-PID evidence; drain blocks reconnects and shutdown rechecks leases, epoch, consumer quiescence, and ownership before bounded graceful/forced termination. Added classified degraded outcomes, detached launch environment/identity evidence, and POSIX zombie-aware liveness. Host fake-process coverage and clean Linux Docker real-process races pass.
user-summary-candidate: Added safe single-owner shared-service launch, attach, drain, and shutdown with ownership proof and real multi-process Docker validation.

technical-summary: Made provider CLI lifecycle results typed at the public API seam and removed direct generated-surfaces and managed-MCP dispatch from install/uninstall so reconciliation remains the single cross-family orchestrator.

technical-summary: Revalidated the shared provider recipe-definition architecture, confirmed provider-level isolation facts and open family registration semantics, and independently re-audited the completed language-server projection boundary.
user-summary-candidate: Closed MA20 and confirmed MA28 still uses the current shared provider patterns without duplicated routes.

technical-summary: Closed the PR07 explicit-owner gap found during SH04 integration. Added reusable current-process ownership evidence and an atomic ManagedServiceOwner claim/retire seam that rejects live competing owners, recovers only dead records with a fresh epoch, verifies non-PID evidence, expires stale leases, and prevents retirement with active clients.
user-summary-candidate: Added safe lifecycle registration for manually started shared services without gateway-local PID or discovery logic.

technical-summary: Closed MA19 as a finite evidence-contract item, removed obsolete exhaustive descriptor-mirroring requirements, clarified runtime descriptor authority, and aligned evidence tests with the shared provider-level isolation contract.

technical-summary: Verified that the MA26 post-completion findings are incorporated through the existing foundation redaction and atomic-write primitives and closed the review with focused validation.

user-summary-candidate: Session requests can now wait without monopolizing profile capacity while actual model work remains strictly bounded by max_concurrency.

technical-summary: Removed orphan CLI lifecycle bulk/repair action dispatch, aligned plan semantics with status/apply intent, promoted the shared CLI probe, converted invalid lifecycle state to an owned error, and distinguished malformed managed-hooks declarations from unsupported capabilities.

Added authenticated IPv4-loopback HTTP, server-enforced version/epoch/active-lease authority, canonical roots, bounded TTL/retry/lease/event retention, explicit client selection without fallback, real process/client-exit/crash tests, and Windows/Linux Docker validation.

technical-summary: Critically reconciled every active agent-sessions item against the landed SH04 standalone gateway, foundation process/workflow/event/path primitives, architecture and observability standards, and provider capability evidence. Created and closed RV649-RV664; rewrote eleven retained items around concrete gaps and bounded Docker-backed validation; deleted AS20, AS22, AS23, AS24, and AS25 because they were unsafe, duplicate, open-ended, or lacked an evidenced trigger; and corrected the capability-reference roadmap and durable-state authority split.

technical-summary: Added the public harness uninstall command and a deterministic local/Docker user-path test that drives public install, repeat install, launch-triggered config refresh, MCP materialization and ownership-safe uninstall. Added a dedicated clean Docker image. Updated the harness MCP lifecycle capability oracle to require declared external executables before expecting external MCP entries, matching the shared collector contract.
user-summary-candidate: Harness lifecycle validation now runs locally and in Docker, including safe uninstall and MCP configuration checks for Pi and OpenCode surfaces.

technical-summary: Completed the coordinated MA17/SH06 cutover. Providers expose typed one-shot execution, provider runtime/tier reads, ACP launch preparation and narrow prompt operations only through providers_api; agents and agent_jobs no longer import provider internals, and providers no longer import agent_jobs. One-shot gateway attempts now run in supervised disposable workers with a versioned private protocol, canonical root/frozen component profile, replacement environment/private home, PID+creation handshake and fail-closed isolation tiers. Docker tests prove conflicting project isolation, secret non-bleed, timeout descendant cleanup and prompt profile worker launch; Docker context now excludes mutable runtime state and creates an empty runtime root.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway jobs now run through isolated worker processes with provider boundaries enforced, and Docker validation covers concurrent profile execution, cleanup, and mutable runtime safety.

technical-summary: Launch the machine-scoped automatic gateway from its ManagedServiceStore directory and clear inherited project-root and component-profile environment variables. Project and profile remain explicit request/manifest context; added declaration coverage.
user-summary-candidate: Automatic shared gateway startup no longer inherits the project context of whichever client starts it first.

technical-summary: Completed the SH06 isolated one-attempt worker boundary with provider-owned OpenCode inline configuration materialization, child-reported PID/creation/CWD handshake evidence, Windows Job Object and POSIX process-group descendant teardown, bounded private-home cleanup, thread-safe lazy registries, and retrying atomic record reads for transient Windows sharing violations.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway jobs now run from the project directory with private provider configuration, all three agent profiles execute concurrently, and crashed or timed-out workers leave no child processes behind.

technical-summary: Hardened the clean Docker test lane: install ACP and process-inspection test dependencies, exclude only nested Docker/daemon tests, run lifecycle-rich coverage serially to avoid xdist toolchain/cache contention, repair no-Docker collection behavior, and keep SH06 worker-isolation tests in the clean lane.
user-summary-candidate: Clean Docker validation now starts reliably, exercises worker isolation, and avoids false failures from nested Docker and unsafe parallel lifecycle provisioning.

technical-summary: Added the first SH07 durable-admission slice: a project-local StartupLock serializes hashed idempotency-key reservations and record writes. The agents-owned index replays an original exact execution intent without re-enqueueing, rejects divergent intent with CON-AGW-081, and deterministically repairs record-only and index-only partial writes. Raw client idempotency keys are stripped from persisted metadata and only SHA-256 digests reach records/indexes.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway submissions now safely replay the original request for duplicate idempotency keys, reject changed work under the same key, and keep client keys out of persisted gateway data.

technical-summary: Aligned planning disable coverage with the authoritative remove-on-disable managed-MCP lifecycle, declared the existing generated-surfaces family for every descriptor-backed renderer, and added a renderer-to-capability contract invariant.
user-summary-candidate: Provider surface generation now works consistently for every registered renderer, and disabling planning correctly removes its managed MCP entries.

technical-summary: Made idempotency replay verify the advisory index against the authoritative persisted request record. The locked admission path now recomputes durable intent, repairs a stale valid index, rejects divergent candidate intent with CON-AGW-081, and discards index entries whose referenced record has a different key digest. Added Docker-covered stale-index, cross-process divergent-contention, and no-duplicate-enqueue replay tests.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway request replays now safely recover from a stale idempotency index without returning or re-queuing the wrong request.

technical-summary: Hardened SH07 submission admission with canonical scalar/session/JSON metadata validation, finite timeout and idempotency bounds, and recursive removal of raw prompt/idempotency metadata aliases before request persistence and lifecycle-event publication.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway submissions now reject malformed input cleanly and never persist or publish prompt/idempotency aliases carried in metadata.

technical-summary: Changed GatewayQueueManager.wait from unconditional 50ms JSON/schema polling to record-stat change detection with bounded exponential backoff and a 500ms validated-read fallback. Added deterministic unchanged-record read-count coverage and an independent-process terminal-write observation test.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway waits now avoid repeated record parsing while still observing terminal results written by another process.

technical-summary: Added forward-only v1-to-v2 gateway-record migration under the per-request lock, an interrupted terminal state, dispatch owner claim/start fencing, and owner-worker-attempt fenced attempt/result writes. Service invocation now supplies its validated owner epoch and public request status omits prompt and admission material.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway requests now retain a safe durable ownership fence and report interruption explicitly when execution cannot be proven.

technical-summary: Applied the complete owner-worker-attempt fence to queue-level exception terminalization as well as normal dispatch results, so fallback failures cannot bypass the v2 dispatch ownership contract.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway fallback failures now obey the same durable ownership protection as normal results.

technical-summary: Treat a claim revision/ownership conflict as expected queue cleanup only when the durable record is already cancelled; retain exceptions for every other conflict. Stabilize the cancellation race assertion around in-memory worker cleanup and make independent-process writes import the mounted source explicitly.
user-summary-candidate: Gateway cancellation no longer produces a background worker exception when it wins the final dispatch-claim race, and cross-process durability tests now exercise the current source tree.

technical-summary: Registered the complete durable dispatch ownership error-code set used by the SH07 fence and closed RV677 after the Docker agents, contract, and architecture validation gates.
user-summary-candidate: Durable request ownership failures now produce supported, actionable gateway errors, with the SH07 cancellation race repair verified in Docker.

technical-summary: Implemented the RV679/RV680/RV681 corrective slices on the agent LLM gateway and foundation process management. Transport: _RAW_TO_CANONICAL now covers the real ACP wire vocabulary; emit_terminal delivers the terminal result event through on_event; compact mode preserves status/tool_call_id; ACP children are adopted into a kill-on-close Job Object on Windows via new adopt_pid_into_kill_job. Sessions: canonical stateful _TurnEventProjector (model.started dedupe, tool.started per tool-call id, tool.completed with completed/failed status, model.completed from terminal event); self-attested precise/execution labels replaced with unknown pending AS19 declaration resolution; per-turn deadline (session-turn-timeout-seconds, TO-AGW-090, close-reason turn-timeout); opt-in in-turn event-silence watchdog (turn-stalled); per-turn cancel_signal wired so agent_llm_cancel interrupts a running session turn via protocol cancel and terminalizes the request cancelled; child pid/creation identity captured at open. Foundation: Windows pid_alive treats ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED as alive; observe_process populates group/cmdline ownership comparisons. Contracts: events.yaml tool topics gain tool-call-id/status; TO-AGW-090 registered; session schema close-reason gains turn-timeout/turn-stalled. Suites green: agents unit+integration 340, foundation transports/system/acp 65, providers 643, jobs/tools/core 209; one pre-existing unrelated schema-mirror-drift failure (provider-model-catalog) from a concurrent workstream left untouched.
user-summary-candidate: Agent gateway stability: hung agent turns now time out instead of blocking the profile forever, cancelling a running session turn actually interrupts it, turn/tool lifecycle events publish correctly for real agent harnesses (including completion and tool failure), and agent child processes can no longer be orphaned when the gateway is hard-killed on Windows.

technical-summary: Refactored AS19 into a provider-declared, lifecycle-managed harness-status-observer capability: generic plan/apply/prune/status contracts, surface/version evidence, adapter-owned injection/removal and normalization, canonical event boundary, and AS21/SH07 authority separation. Added AS27 as the first evidence-first Gemini CLI hook integration investigation.
user-summary-candidate: Planned generic harness status observer integration with safe enablement/removal and added a bounded Gemini hook validation path.

technical-summary: Expanded the harness status-observer plans into an implementation contract: typed descriptor and API shapes, automation family, owned reconcile scope, lifecycle events, per-session observer lease, authenticated loopback ingress/emitter, OpenCode ACP adapter, and an evidence-gated Gemini hook implementation path.
user-summary-candidate: Made the harness status-observer plans implementation-ready, including exact enablement, cleanup, event delivery, and test requirements.

technical-summary: Expanded AS27 from a Gemini-only investigation into a code-level recipe catalogue for every reference-profile and configured harness. It defines attach-only ACP, managed-hook, structured-output, and unsupported recipes; names per-harness adapter targets, launch/probe gates, managed IDs, config rules, and conservative fallback behavior.
user-summary-candidate: Added concrete status-observer implementation recipes and safe fallbacks for every known harness.

technical-summary: SH09 complete: foundation DurableSpoolTransport (atomic file spool, ordered consume, ack-by-delete, bounded transient retries, dead-letter with replay, closed topic set) plus agents_gateway_ingress thin adapter mapping spool event-id to SH07 idempotency keys and admitting triggers only through the public GatewayApplication; GatewayServiceHost drains at startup and polls at 1s. Cross-process publish proven with a real second OS process in integration. New error factories VAL/CON-AGLC, VAL/IO-SPOOL. 25+12 unit tests, 2 new integration tests; agents+foundation suites 1240 passed (one pre-existing unrelated schema-mirror-drift failure from a concurrent workstream).
user-summary-candidate: Gateway triggers can now be published durably from any process — even while the gateway is down — and are admitted exactly once when it runs; the gateway can also manage its own lifetime, shutting down after a configurable idle window and offering operators safe drain/stop and record-only recovery for a dead service owner.

technical-summary: Added AS28 with implementation semantics for a provider-neutral session transport/control seam and rebased status-observer plans on it. ACP is now a provider-declared adapter surface that maps privately to foundation TransportObservation; persistent hooks/plugins reuse existing Hindsight-style providers_api reconciliation families.
user-summary-candidate: Planned a provider-neutral session-control seam so ACP and native harness controls stay isolated from gateway logic.

user-summary-candidate: Specified the exact cleanup required to remove ACP leakage from gateway sessions while retaining ACP only behind provider adapters.
